name: Metaxalone
indications_original: Metaxalone tablets are indicated as an adjunct to rest, physical therapy, and other measures for the relief of discomforts associated with acute, painful musculoskeletal conditions. The mode of action of this drug has not been clearly identified, but may be related to its sedative properties. Metaxalone does not directly relax tense skeletal muscles in man.
contraindications_original: The recommended dose for adults and children over 12 years of age is one 800 mg tablet three to four times a day.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
